## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL — Breadth: 1/11 sectors positive (Energy only). Confirmations: extreme sector narrowness (only Energy positive) and narrow leadership concentration (Top 5: 4/5 Technology), with major tech divergences (AMD/INTC/QCOM/META ABOVE TREND vs NVDA/MSFT/GOOGL BELOW TREND). Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +2.33% | 1M: +4.58%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +9.83%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +5.32% | 1M: +18.23%) ABOVE TREND. Technology shows pockets of strength despite sector weakness: AMD (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +12.29% | 1M: +1.97%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +7.95% | 1M: +12.20%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Healthcare lagging: UNH (1W: -5.45% | 1M: -6.53%) BELOW TREND, AMGN (1W: -15.03% | 1M: -8.80%) BELOW TREND, NVS (1W: -15.90% | 1M: -9.95%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary and Materials also weak on the week (SBUX (1W: -6.69% | 1M: -8.46%) BELOW TREND; FCX sentiment negative).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: AMD (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +12.29% | 1M: +1.97%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +7.95% | 1M: +12.20%) ABOVE TREND, ETN (1W: +7.11% | 1M: -7.52%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +6.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology) — selectivity required.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: INTU (1W: -6.60% | 1M: -3.93%) BELOW TREND, SBUX (1W: -6.69% | 1M: -8.46%) BELOW TREND, PLTR (1W: -8.38% | 1M: -2.23%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -8.97% | 1M: +6.07%) CORRECTION, SYK (1W: -10.53% | 1M: -20.64%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in select Tech names and Healthcare.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Big 1W momentum: AMD (1W: +13.15%), INTC (1W: +12.29%), QCOM (1W: +7.95%), ETN (1W: +7.11%), META (1W: +6.12%) — all showing strong short-term flows. Major divergence flagged: NVDA (1W: -4.34% | 1M: -2.48%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -2.84% | 1M: +0.84%) CORRECTION and GOOGL (1W: -1.10% | 1M: -1.40%) BELOW TREND — tactical moves, not broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed with concentrated winners and large-cap laggards; sector 1W: -0.21% (24 stocks). AAPL (1W: +1.24% | 1M: +9.93%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +12.29% | 1M: +1.97%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +7.95% | 1M: +12.20%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: -4.34% | 1M: -2.48%) BELOW TREND — internal rotation, watch for follow-through.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials are soft on the week (1W: -1.78%); leadership mixed. JPM (1W: -1.61% | 1M: -2.45%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -2.19% | 1M: +3.07%) CORRECTION, MA (1W: -2.82% | 1M: +1.69%) CORRECTION — cautious on cyclical exposure until breadth improves.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Weak sector (1W: -5.60%) with several large-cap breakouts to the downside. UNH (1W: -5.45% | 1M: -6.53%) BELOW TREND, AMGN (1W: -15.03% | 1M: -8.80%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -3.79% | 1M: -8.44%) BELOW TREND — defensive names not uniformly holding up.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor selective Energy and the handful of Technology names showing clear ABOVE TREND strength (e.g., AMD, QCOM, META) while reducing exposure to weak Healthcare and lagging Consumer Discretionary. Given NEUTRAL regime and narrow leadership, maintain selectivity and monitor for confirmation rather than broad reallocation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: AMD (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND, QCOM (1W: +7.95% | 1M: +12.20%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +5.32% | 1M: +18.23%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -4.34% | 1M: -2.48%) BELOW TREND, UNH (1W: -5.45% | 1M: -6.53%) BELOW TREND, AMGN (1W: -15.03% | 1M: -8.80%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (Breadth: 1/11 sectors positive; Energy 1W: +1.37% — pockets of strength). BEARISH: Healthcare (1W: -5.60%) and Consumer Discretionary (1W: -3.31%) for continued weakness and headline risk.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA: watch failure to reclaim weekly highs as a trend-break trigger (1W: -4.34% | 1M: -2.48%) BELOW TREND. AMD: sustainment above this week’s highs (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) keeps ABOVE TREND momentum. XOM/CVX: hold weekly support to confirm Energy breadth (XOM 1W: +2.33% | 1M: +4.58% ABOVE TREND; CVX 1W: +1.30% | 1M: +9.83% ABOVE TREND). META: breakout follow-through above recent resistance would reinforce sector leadership (1W: +6.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
QCOM (+80): headline around Amazon bid shows actionable M&A chatter; QCOM (1W: +7.95% | 1M: +12.20%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. BA (+60): F-15/contract headlines but BA (1W: -0.03% | 1M: -8.97%) BELOW TREND — news not yet reflected in price (divergence). JNJ (+55): deal talks with Apollo and JNJ (1W: -4.62% | 1M: +2.31%) CORRECTION — mixed confirmation.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
NVS (-60): negative trial headlines and NVS (1W: -15.90% | 1M: -9.95%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. AMGN (-50): trial-related drop and AMGN (1W: -15.03% | 1M: -8.80%) BELOW TREND — confirmed. C (-45): negative coverage and C (news) with modest weakness; monitor for follow-through.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime, style mixed / no clear leadership given Energy’s lone sector strength and narrow tech leadership. AMD (1W: +13.15% | 1M: +6.87%) ABOVE TREND and QCOM (1W: +7.95% | 1M: +12.20%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength while NVDA (1W: -4.34% | 1M: -2.48%) BELOW TREND and major Healthcare names are showing weakness. Key risk is narrow leadership and news-driven divergences (QCOM bullish headline confirmed; NVS/AMGN bearish headlines confirmed) — watch for breadth expansion before shifting positioning.
